title: Fixed-degree comparison of the Grothendieck edge and the cocycle quotient
statement: Let F: A -> B and G: B -> C be additive left exact functors between Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-composite-acyclicity], with derived categories, and assume F sends injectives to G-acyclics. Let X be an object of A, I an injective resolution of X [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and n a natural number. Put K=F(I) and T=(F composed with G)(I). Let c: G(Z^n(K)) -> Z^n(T) be any morphism satisfying c composed with iCycles_T = G(iCycles_K). Then c composed with the quotient Z^n(T) -> H^n(T), the inverse comparison H^n(T) -> R^n(F composed with G)(X), the canonical Grothendieck left edge [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps], and G of the comparison R^nF(X) -> H^n(K), equals G of the quotient Z^n(K) -> H^n(K). The comparisons are those of [lem-sp-derived-well-defined]; the right derived functors and degree-zero identifications are those of [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. This is a fixed-degree equation for a supplied c; it asserts neither existence of c, filtration properties nor collapse.
